decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south-west flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The carport and studio hereby permitted shall not be used at any time other than for the parking of vehicles and purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 7 Harvard Road, Chiswick, London W4 4EA. These buildings shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.

Condition : 6 - No development involving any amendments to the construction or materials of the extension hereby permitted that are necessary to meet Building Regulations shall be undertaken until details are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Demolition of existing carport/ garage in rear garden erection of a new car port with roof, single storey studio and a shed in rear garden and erection of single storey side conservatory to house.
